# Invoice Generator Skill for Muse

Professional invoices for freelancers and small businesses: multi-currency line items with VAT, GST, and sales-tax calculations, plus region-by-region tax guidance (US state rates, EU VAT and reverse charge, China's fapiao, Australia's 10% GST), payment terms (Net 30, 2/10 Net 30), late-fee language, invoice-numbering best practices, and output as a clean formatted document ready for Word, Google Docs, or HTML — with optional MCP tools for DOCX/PDF export. It works in English and Chinese. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: content is bilingual EN/ZH — prompts and examples mix both languages; tax rates are reference snapshots, so verify with your accountant and local rules — it generates invoices, it doesn't guarantee compliance or file taxes for you; no payment processing, no standalone PDF export. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
